priorities.summary: Multiple CWE-347 cryptographic signature-verification flaws in Cisco License On-Prem (formerly Smart Software Manager On-Prem), found during an internal security review that also used frontier AI models. Affects all releases; the only remediation is the October 7 hardening release.

XQuery injection in a deprecated Management API package path in Progress MarkLogic Server (11.x before 11.3.7, 12.x before 12.1.0) lets a remote attacker with manage-user privileges obtain persistent administrative control. One of 31 flaws in Progress's October 14 critical bulletin.

Zero-day in the Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway: improper handling of email attachments with File Reputation enabled lets an unauthenticated remote attacker write arbitrary files and execute commands with root privileges. Actively exploited; CISA added it to the KEV catalog on October 14 with a 3-day deadline.

model.name: Grok Voice 3.0
model.summary: xAI's new speech-to-speech voice model launched October 14, taking over the grok-voice-latest alias (Grok Voice 2.0 is deprecated). It tops the Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Index at 86.9 with sub-second latency, at the same price as its predecessor.
